notes: Balance update. Fixes set: summon replaces a spirit when the board is full; Cultivator relic once; PvP pays on corruption (no bounty on Good players), +VP for engaging; attacker sacrifice cap; Corruptor counts as corruption; Fallen debt below zero; Sun rework; monsters have initiative and new Barrier/Damage values; Bastion and Firetail work against monsters; new class texts for Mage, Chorus, Shieldbearer, Nomad, Gardener, Cleric. Arcane Abyss summon: draw 4, summon up to 2. Power rework: 22 Powers, 11 general and 11 niche, none needs another player to be Evil.
